about: The trained models of AegisPilot ML. They are not in the repository: `guard_cli.py ml-install` downloads them from the GitHub release below and refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. The guard checks the hashes again before each run.

trained.threshold_rule: 5-fold out-of-fold scores: the alert threshold is the top 5% of benign scores (5% false alarms on benign packages)
